lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gills. Primary spots are distributed in vertical columns of 3-4 nodes, with horizontal spacing approximately equidistant between vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with several high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A linear horizontal indentation or scar-like feature is present at the insertion point of the pectoral fin, highlighted by an artificial black arrow. An irregular dark-toned patch is also visible immediately superior to this mark.
other_distinctive_markers: An artificial black graphical arrow is overlaid on the image, pointing towards a specific feature at the base of the pectoral fin.
